form_analysis.feedback: Excellent aftercare form for stretch mark laser treatment with clear differentiation between red/white phases. Strong guidance on collagen stimulation protocols and realistic expectations. Good emphasis on prevention of new stretch marks and combination therapies.

form_data.introduction: This aftercare is for laser treatment of striae (stretch marks). Treatment aims to stimulate collagen to improve texture, reduce width/depth, and normalize color. Response varies significantly between red/inflammatory vs. white/atrophic stretch marks.

instructions.general_directive: Follow this care plan for 2-4 weeks with ongoing collagen support for 6+ months. Early stretch marks respond best.

sections.title: Stretch Mark Types & Response
items: Red Stretch Marks (Striae Rubra): Active, inflammatory. BEST responders to vascular lasers (PDL) + fractional. 50-70% improvement typical.
White Stretch Marks (Striae Alba): Mature, atrophic. More challenging. Require aggressive collagen stimulation. 30-50% improvement typical.

sections.title: Immediate Post-Treatment Response
items: Red marks: May darken then lighten over 2-3 weeks.
White marks: Pinpoint bleeding, redness, swelling for 5-7 days.
Both: Sandpaper texture, then flaking over 7-14 days.
DO NOT SCRATCH OR PICK.

sections.title: Collagen Stimulation Protocol
items: Critical Phase: Months 2-6 post-treatment when new collagen forms.
Support with: Vitamin C serum (after 4 weeks), retinoids (after 8 weeks), peptide creams.
Micro-needling at home (after 4 weeks) can enhance results.
Stay hydrated and maintain stable weight.

sections.title: Topical Enhancement Regimen
items: Hyaluronic acid for hydration immediately post-treatment.
Retinoids (prescription strength) after 8 weeks to remodel collagen.
Centella asiatica, peptides for collagen support.
Avoid topical steroids which can thin skin.

sections.title: Realistic Expectations
items: Improvement, not elimination. Stretch marks are scars.
Red marks: 3-5 treatments, 4-6 week intervals.
White marks: 5-8 treatments, 6-8 week intervals.
Texture improves before color. Width reduction before complete fading.
Some fine silvery lines may remain.

sections.title: Prevention of New Stretch Marks
sections.content: During pregnancy/weight changes: Moisturize with centella/hyaluronic acid creams. Maintain gradual weight changes. Consider preventive micro-needling or laser if high risk.

sections.title: Combination Therapies
items: Laser + micro-needling: Enhanced collagen induction.
Laser + radiofrequency: For deeper collagen remodeling.
Laser + topical retinoids: Synergistic effect.
Platelet-rich plasma (PRP): Can boost results.

patient_declaration.reading_confirmation: Stretch mark improvement requires consistent collagen support over many months.
patient_declaration.question_opportunity: Ask about combining treatments for your specific stretch mark type and color.
patient_declaration.declaration_text: I understand stretch marks cannot be completely eliminated but can be significantly improved with multiple treatments.
